name: Kind Curios / 070
plan_decision: A recessed glazed entrance opens obliquely past paired display bays into a broad central browsing room; tapered rear shoulders gather around a wrapping/service counter. The route remains clear between destination groups.
section_decision: A lower entrance canopy gives way to a raised central ceiling, then lowers over the counter and peripheral display bays; substantial columns anchor the street frontage. No new deck holes or upper business are implied.
scope: Actual historical shop allocation and stable ID; first authored interior in current rebuild. Sales, merchandise pickup, NPC use and existing facility slots are not claimed.
